title: U-Net++
paper_title: UNet++: Redesigning Skip Connections to Exploit Multiscale Features in Image Segmentation
core_mech: 以 X_i,j 嵌套稠密卷积节点重写 U-Net 跳连，并从多个顶层节点施加深监督。
core_mech_en: Rewrites U-Net skip pathways as a dense nested grid of intermediate convolutional nodes X_{i,j} with multi-depth deep supervision.
output_desc: 深监督融合或选定深度的分割概率图
output_en: Deeply supervised ensemble or depth-pruned segmentation probability map

adapter.name: U-Net++
adapter.mechanism: Nested decoder grid concatenates all earlier same-scale nodes, with supervised heads at each decoder depth.
limitations: Random initialization and synthetic data; no original benchmark result or pretrained capability is reproduced.
Three-level, narrow independent port; original pruning/clinical experiments and nnU-Net trainer not reproduced.
